items.title: Chef Carving a Turkey Roast
items.alt: A smiling chef in a white toque and blue apron carves a turkey roast at a narrow wooden stand beside cranberry sauce and rolls.
items.description: Round glasses and short curls distinguish the chef, whose knife and fork frame the pale slices exposed beneath the browned crust.

items.title: Turkey Feast with Stuffed Squash
items.alt: A golden roast turkey shares a copper handled platter with two filled squash halves and a cranberry sauce bowl.
items.description: Herbs and red berries connect the larger bird at the rear to the two long grain-filled squash halves angled across the front.

items.title: Turkey Feast Picnic Hamper
items.alt: An open wicker hamper contains a roast turkey in an enamel dish beside cranberry sauce, rolls and folded green napkins.
items.description: Leather straps and a complete front handle frame the deep basket, while its upright woven lid leaves each packed item visible.

items.title: Friends Sharing a Turkey Feast
items.alt: Three smiling cartoon friends share a roast-turkey meal at a round wooden table while passing a bowl of green beans.
items.description: Mustard, teal and plum tops distinguish the diners, with plated portions, mashed potatoes and gravy arranged around the centerpiece.

items.title: Neighbors Bringing a Turkey Potluck
items.alt: Three cartoon neighbors carry a roast turkey, a bread basket and a pumpkin pie for a shared meal.
items.description: A tall woman in green, an older man in denim and a shorter woman in a coral dress hold their dishes across a varied group silhouette.

items.title: Children Sharing a Turkey Feast
items.alt: Four smiling cartoon children share a roast turkey, corn, fruit and rolls around a small wooden table.
items.description: Different hairstyles, bows and green, yellow, blue and pink outfits distinguish the children as one offers a bread roll across the food.
